name: Actors
summary:
The original VR game, Actors, puts you right into the shoes of a working actor. You dive in by first reading the script. Next, the director explains their creative vision, and you get plenty of time to learn every move, every line. Once you nail it, the real shoot begins. Lights! Camera! Action! Now, the stage is all yours! Embrace the challenge! A single mistake might mean starting the scene again.
